editorial.premise: A mountain-climbing game unexpectedly becomes an animated rainbow journey with cartoon figures and a mysterious clinical room.
editorial.payoff: The colorful path eventually reaches a sterile-looking room.
editorial.novelty_reason: Visual surrealism and cartoon transformation rather than a standard climbing-danger hook.
editorial.evidence: rainbow_entry 43:26–43:49 and rainbow_payoff 44:07–44:42 video previews, with source timestamps.
beats: Colorful rainbow path beneath a silhouetted figure
Animated cowboy-like characters race through the clouds
The path leads into a clinical-looking room

spoilers.rationale: A revealing midgame surreal cutscene, but not the ending.

clips.narration: Why did my climbing game suddenly become a cartoon?
clips.caption: A CARTOON IN CAIRN?
clips.evidence: Rainbow path under the silhouetted climber.

clips.narration: A glowing rainbow road appears out of absolutely nowhere.
clips.caption: A RAINBOW ROAD?
clips.evidence: Rainbow road extends into the sky.

clips.narration: Then animated characters start flying in from every direction.
clips.caption: AND THEN THIS...
clips.evidence: Animated characters appear and move across the screen.

clips.narration: A giant crowned face takes over the entire scene.
clips.caption: A GIANT CROWNED FACE
clips.evidence: Large crowned animated character visible on the rainbow path.

clips.narration: And the rainbow leads somewhere much darker than I expected.
clips.caption: IT GETS DARKER
clips.evidence: Rainbow becomes red tunnel with unsettling animal face.

clips.narration: A strange laboratory? Seriously? Subscribe for more.
clips.caption: WHAT WAS THAT?
clips.evidence: Rainbow enters clinical-looking room at about 44:34–44:40.
